title: Sunday Service Choir - Jesus Is Born
description: The cover art to JESUS IS BORN uses similar artistic motifs to JESUS IS KING. The font and gold-colored writing used on both arts is the same, as well as identical blue hues seen in both covers. Blue is a common color seen in Christianity that is used to symbolize sky, representing Heaven, eternity, and truth in religion. The water seen on the art's cover is a common symbol in the religion, as Holy Water is a symbol of purity and cleansing of sin within the faith.

description:
Graduation is the third studio album from Kanye West. Inspiration came from stadium tours, indie rock, and house music. It was a considerable departure from the sound Kanye had used on his first two studio albums, which featured samples and inspirations from the soul and orchestral music Kanye grew up alongside. This album included a much more electronic sound, featuring layering synthesizers. Lyrically, Kanye analyzes himself and talks about his life after becoming famous and how the media criticize him.

title: Unknown [Madvillainz Collaborations]
description: It is heavily implied that Kanye, MF DOOM and Madlib formed a supergroup called Madvillainz in 2009. After MF DOOM's death, rapper J Rocc revealed that Kanye and MF DOOM wanted to form a group called Madvillainz. Kanye's barber Ibn Jasper also said in an Instagram post that he'll always remember the secret studio sessions, implying DOOM and Kanye recorded together. The first Madvillainz remix that released, "Gazillion Ear", featured a Kanye intro. When the Madvillainz remix of "Victory Laps" came out, DOOM's label Lex Records stated that Madvillainz was allegedly made up of Kanye, Madlib, and DOOM. Talib Kweli also tweeted out in 2009 that he was in the studio with Kanye, DOOM and Madlib, although allegedly no music was recorded. It is likely more music came out of the Madvillainz group than just the "Gazillion Ear" and "Victory Lap" remixes and "Disastrous".

description:
After Kanye was released from UCLA Medical Hospital and diagnosed as bipolar, he bought a ranch in Wyoming where he would produce his next album and multiple albums for his collaborators. The concept of the album came together in 2018. The album's subject matter varied wildly, with some songs being about introspection and change and others discussing his political views. The public name given for this album is LOVE EVERYONE, but it is known that Kanye likely considered the Hitler title longer, with this later being corroborated by Hassan Khaffaf on a stream with Auger.
